column1: # D. A class, struct, union and enum are class, an interface is interface, `alias X = T` is
# type_alias. A function is function at the module level (nested ones too) and method in the body of
# a class, struct, union or interface; a constructor is the method `this`. A variable at the top of the
# module is variable, one in an aggregate is field.
# Not definitions: parameters, locals, enum members, a destructor, `unittest` blocks, import and module.
